title: Knowledge Item Frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter block of Knowledge Item files under shared/knowledge/*.md and .claude/knowledge/*.md. Source of truth: shared/contracts/ki-frontmatter-contract.md.

name.description: kebab-case identifier; must match filename base.

tags.description: Free-form tag list. Convention: use lowercase kebab-case tags; reuse existing tags in the corpus before inventing new ones.

domain.description: Which bounded context this KI applies to (e.g., testing, architecture, deployment, retrieval, mcp-server-pattern).

created.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Immutable — set once at authoring time. The staleness math downstream expects this exact shape.
